sentences.en: INTERVIEWER: Today we're pleased to have on the show Alice Bussell from the Dolphin Conservation Trust.
sentences.zh: INTERVIEWER: 今天，我们非常荣幸地邀请到海豚保护信托基金的爱丽丝·巴塞尔女士做客本节目。

sentences.en: Tell us about the Trust, Alice.
sentences.zh: 请为我们介绍一下该信托基金，爱丽丝。

sentences.en: ALICE: Well, obviously its purpose is to protect dolphins in seas all around the world.
sentences.zh: ALICE: 当然，其宗旨是保护全球海域中的海豚。

sentences.en: It tries to raise people's awareness of the problems these marine creatures are suffering because of pollution and other threats.
sentences.zh: 该组织致力于提高公众对这些海洋生物所面临问题的认识——它们正因污染及其他威胁而遭受苦难。

sentences.en: It started ten years ago and it's one of the fastest growing animal charities in the country - although it's still fairly small compared with the big players in animal protection.
sentences.zh: 该信托基金成立于十年前，是本国发展最快的动物保护慈善机构之一；不过，与那些大型动物保护组织相比，它目前规模仍相对较小。

sentences.en: We are particularly proud of the work we do in education - last year we visited a huge number of schools in different parts of the country, going round to talk to children and young people aged from five to eighteen.
sentences.zh: 我们在教育领域的工作尤为值得自豪——去年，我们在全国不同地区访问了大量学校，向五至十八岁的儿童和青少年开展宣讲活动。

sentences.en: In fact, about thirty-five per cent of our members are children.
sentences.zh: 事实上，我们约百分之三十五的会员是儿童。

sentences.en: The charity uses its money to support campaigns. & 12 - for example, for changes in fishing policy and so forth. t hopes soon to be able to employ its first full-time biologist - with dolphin expertise - to monitor populations.
sentences.zh: 该慈善机构将资金用于支持各类倡议活动，例如推动渔业政策改革等；此外，我们希望不久后能聘用首位全职生物学家（专精于海豚研究），以监测海豚种群状况。

sentences.en: Of course, many people give their services on a voluntary basis and we now have volunteers working in observation, office & 12 work and other things.
sentences.zh: 当然，许多人士以志愿者身份无偿提供服务；目前，我们的志愿者已参与到观测、办公室工作及其他各项事务中。

sentences.en: I should also tell you about the award we won from the Charity Commission last year - for our work in education.
sentences.zh: 我还应向您介绍：我们去年荣获了英国慈善委员会颁发的教育工作奖。

sentences.en: Although it's not meant an enormous amount of money for us, it has made our activities even more widely publicised and understood.
sentences.zh: 尽管这笔奖金并未为我们带来巨额资金，但它极大地提升了我们各项活动的公众知晓度与社会理解度。

sentences.en: In the long term it may not it bring in extra members but we're hoping it'll have this effect.
sentences.zh: 从长远来看，它或许未必能显著增加会员人数，但我们希望它能产生这一效果。

sentences.en: Audioscripts
sentences.zh: 听力原文

sentences.en: INTERVIEWER: Is it possible to see dolphins in UK waters?
sentences.zh: INTERVIEWER: 在英国海域有可能看到海豚吗？

sentences.en: ALICE: Yes.
sentences.zh: ALICE: 可以。

sentences.en: In several locations.
sentences.zh: 在多个地点都能看到。

sentences.en: And we a have a big project in the east part of Scotland.
sentences.zh: 我们在苏格兰东部开展了一项大型项目。

sentences.en: This has long been a haven for dolphins because it has very little shipping.
sentences.zh: 该地区长期以来一直是海豚的庇护所，因为当地航运活动极少。

sentences.en: However, that may be about to change soon because oil companies want to increase exploration there.
sentences.zh: 然而，这种情况可能很快就会改变，因为石油公司计划在此加大勘探力度。

sentences.en: We're campaigning against this because, although there'll be little pollution from oil, exploration creates a lot of underwater noise.
sentences.zh: 我们正就此展开反对运动，因为尽管石油开采本身造成的污染较少，但勘探活动却会产生大量水下噪音。

sentences.en: It means the dolphins can't rest and socialise.
sentences.zh: 这意味着海豚无法休息和社交。

sentences.en: This is how I became interested in dolphin conservation in the first place.
sentences.zh: 我最初就是因此对海豚保护产生了兴趣。

sentences.en: had never seen one and I hadn't been particularly interested in them at school.
sentences.zh: 我以前从未见过海豚，而且在学校时也并未对它们特别感兴趣。

sentences.en: Then I came across this story about a family of dolphins who had to leave their home in the Moray Firth because of the oil companies and about a child who campaigned to save them.
sentences.zh: 后来，我读到一则关于一群海豚的故事：由于石油公司的活动，它们被迫离开了自己在莫莱湾的家园；还有一位儿童为拯救它们而发起运动。

sentences.en: I couldn't put the book down - was hooked,
sentences.zh: 我爱不释手——彻底着迷了。

sentences.en: INTERVIEWER: I'm sure our listeners will want to find out what they can do to help.
sentences.zh: INTERVIEWER: 我相信我们的听众一定很想了解自己能做些什么来提供帮助。

sentences.en: You mentioned the 'Adopt a Dolphin' scheme.
sentences.zh: 您提到了‘领养一只海豚’计划。

sentences.en: Can you tell us about that?
sentences.zh: 您能为我们介绍一下这个计划吗？

sentences.en: ALICE: Of course!
sentences.zh: ALICE: 当然可以！

sentences.en: People can choose one of our dolphins to sponsor.
sentences.zh: 人们可以选择我们其中一只海豚进行资助。

sentences.en: They receive a picture of it and news updates.
sentences.zh: 资助者会收到该海豚的照片以及最新动态更新。

sentences.en: I'd like to tell you about four which are currently being adopted by our members: Moondancer, Echo, Kiwi and Samson.
sentences.zh: 我想向大家介绍目前正由我们的会员领养的四只海豚：月舞者（Moondancer）、回声（Echo）、奇异鸟（Kiwi）和参孙（Samson）。

sentences.en: Unfortunately, Echo is being rather elusive this year and hasn't yet been sighted by our observers but we remain optimistic that he'll be out there soon.
sentences.zh: 遗憾的是，回声今年行踪颇为隐秘，我们的观察员至今尚未发现它的踪迹，但我们仍乐观地相信它很快就会现身。

sentences.en: All the others have been out in force Samson and Moondancer are often photographed together but it is Kiwi who's our real 'character' as she seems to love coming up close for the cameras and we've captured her on film hundreds of times.
sentences.zh: 其余三只则非常活跃：参孙和月舞者经常一同被拍到，但真正称得上‘个性明星’的却是奇异鸟，因为她似乎格外喜欢靠近相机，我们已数百次成功拍摄到她的影像。

sentences.en: They all have their own personalities - Moondancer is very elegant and curves out and into the water very smoothly, whereas Samson has a lot of energy - he's.
sentences.zh: 它们每只都拥有独特的个性——月舞者非常优雅，入水与出水的动作流畅而优美；而参孙则精力充沛——

sentences.en: always leaping out of the water with great vigour.
sentences.zh: 他总是充满活力地跃出水面。

sentences.en: You'd probably expect him to be the youngest - he's not quite - that's Kiwi but Samson's the latest of our dolphins to be chosen for the scheme.
sentences.zh: 您或许会以为他最年轻——其实并非如此——最年轻的是奇异鸟，但参孙却是我们最新入选该计划的海豚。

sentences.en: Kiwi makes a lot of noise so we can often pick her out straightaway.
sentences.zh: 奇异鸟发出的声音很大，因此我们通常能立刻将她辨认出来。

sentences.en: Echo and Moondancer are noisy too, but Moondancer's easy to find because she has a particularly large fin on her back, which makes her easy to identify.
sentences.zh: 回声和月舞者也很爱发声，但月舞者很容易被找到，因为她背鳍特别大，便于识别。

sentences.en: So, yes, they're all very different...
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，它们彼此之间差异非常明显……

sentences.en: INTERVIEWER: Well, they sound a fascinating group
sentences.zh: INTERVIEWER: 嗯，他们听起来是一群非常有趣的人
